How to Apply
To apply to any of our graduate programs Apply online, and use your credit card to pay the $30 application fee. Our Department is unable to waive the $30.00 application fee.
Official transcripts should be mailed in a sealed envelope from each post-secondary
institution you have attended (excluding USF) directly to the Office of Admissions.

For USF general or program specific admission requirements
USF General Admission Requirements
M.S. Biology
M.S. Conservation Biology
Ph.D. Integrative Biology
GRE admission requirements are waived for applications received after July 2020.
Application Materials Required in addition to USF General Admission Requirements
CV/Resume
3 Letters of recommendation. Letters must be signed and on letterhead and uploaded as a pdf to your application. Emails with links will be sent directly to recommenders once
application fee is paid.
Transcripts. Unoffical transcripts accepted for review process only.
Personal Statement/Essay (please review information below)
Teaching or Research funding (If interested in a TA please review the Graduate Assistant information below).
Applicants are required to submit documentation via the on-line application process
only.
personal statement (Essay)
A short statement stating your intended field of research and professional goals.
Please indicate your specific research interests. In your statement please list 2-3 biology faculty members who you would like to have review your file. Faculty bios are listed under the Research Themes of the Department website available
at https://www.usf.edu/arts-sciences/departments/ib/research/index.aspx. Acceptance into the biology graduate program requires the identification of specific
faculty who are willing to direct your research. Applicants are therefore encouraged
to get in contact with faculty they would like to conduct research with.
Graduate Assistantships
For full consideration for a graduate assistantship, the deadline for application
to the Integrative Biology Graduate Program is November 30, for Fall admission. For Fall applications will be accepted on a contingency basis until the USF Graduate
School deadline in February, but please be aware that assistantships may have been
offered to earlier applicants.
Application Deadlines
For U.S. Students:
Spring Term (January): July 1
Fall Term (August): Nov. 30 - Feb. 15. November 30 is the priority deadline for Fall graduate assistantships.
For International Students:
Spring Term (January): July 1
Fall Term (August): Nov. 30. November 30 is the priority deadline for Fall graduate assistantships.
